layout: Create one production anime pixel-edged GAME ANIMATION SPRITE SHEET matching this reference character. EXACTLY FIVE COLUMNS and SIX ROWS, 30 equal cells, no grid lines, no labels or text. Transparent background, no aura, no external effects or projectiles. Each cell contains exactly one COMPLETE full-body character, feet and hair within its cell with transparent margin. Consistent body scale, baseline and facing RIGHT in three-quarter view. Rows1/2 BASE FORM exactly like reference. Rows3/4 FIRST TRANSFORMATION. Rows5/6 SECOND TRANSFORMATION. For EACH form repeat TEN poses in this exact reading order: idle guard; alternate breathing idle; shooting open palm extended right; charging palm shot braced; beam release both cupped hands extended right; straight punch right; hurt recoil leaning back; blocking crossed forearms; power-up fists at hips legs braced; special attack deep stance cupped hands aimed right. Exactly two arms and legs, preserve face and character identity throughout. Full-body poses never overlap neighboring cells.

designs.redhair: BASE red spiky hair, white scarf cape, black sleeveless top, white trousers red sash. FIRST FLAME AWAKENED: brighter swept red-orange hair tipped gold, copper ember markings on bare arms, charcoal vest with gold borders, white trousers red sash, white scarf. SECOND INFERNO SOVEREIGN: huge golden-orange swept flame-shaped hair with crimson roots, black and gold shoulder/chest armor, red ember inset panels, copper bracers, ivory trousers, long red-white split scarf. Face visible, fierce human flame martial artist.
designs.green: BASE bald green pointed-ear alien, white scarf shoulder mantle, purple martial gi and trousers. FIRST EMERALD SURGE: darker jade skin, pale green glowing arm runes, white high collar mantle, silver bracers, violet gi, sharp eyes. SECOND VERDANT GUARDIAN: forest-green skin, gold forehead crest/diadem over bald head, organic ivory and emerald chest shoulder and shin plates, gold-edged purple trousers, flowing white cape, lime inset gems. Still bald alien with long pointed ears and visible green face, not a human or robot.
designs.redgi: BASE black spiky hair, red sleeveless gi, navy blue sash, white wrist wraps black boots. FIRST CRIMSON RUSH: long upward swept burgundy-red hair, brighter crimson gi black edged, black forearm wraps with red markings, dark blue sash. SECOND SCARLET DRAGON: long windswept ivory hair with crimson streak, red black gold-edged sleeveless dragon-pattern martial tunic, gold dragon-shaped forearm guards, crimson trousers, dark navy sash, red eyes. Visible recognizable human face, martial artist rather than full robot.
designs.gold: BASE silver-lavender high ponytail, gold diadem, dark charcoal fitted martial armor with white/gold shoulder accents, gold bracers and dark trousers. FIRST RADIANT VALOR: bright golden high ponytail, white gold diadem, elegant white-gold shoulder chest bracer armor over charcoal martial suit, amber eyes. SECOND SOLAR EMPRESS: long brilliant white-gold flowing ponytail, elaborate gold sun crown, ornate polished gold ivory armor with orange gem chest core, layered hip guards over white/charcoal trousers, gold boots. Visible same face, regal athletic martial fighter, no giant wings.
designs.mage: BASE short teal hair, ivory long gold-trimmed coat over dark martial outfit, no floating orbs in sheet. FIRST ARCANE RESONANCE: bright ice-blue hair, cyan eyes, navy and ivory split long coat with luminous cyan runes and gold edges, gold bracers, dark trousers. SECOND ASTRAL ARCHMAGE: long swept silver-teal hair, star-shaped gold forehead circlet, deep navy/ivory ornate gold-trimmed battle mage coat, cyan star gems on chest and cuffs, layered shoulder guards, ivory boots, flowing coat tails. Visible human face, no staff no floating objects or big hat.
